en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3108 - Hamzah ibn Humran asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the one who says, "Release me where You have prevented me."

Imam (as) replied: "He is released where Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has prevented him."
Then Imam (as) added: "Doesn't he say that?
However, making this condition does not exempt him from performing Hajj the following year."
